verdict.rationale: Mistral publishes per-model card pages, including one for the flagship Mistral Large 3, which describes its capabilities ("open-weight, general-purpose, flagship multimodal and multilingual"). Supporting material includes a model-weights page with usage guidelines and a known-limitations page. Nothing in the evidence shows these cards cover training approach or evaluation results, so only part of the story is confirmed. Missing for 10: evidence that the flagship card documents training approach, published evaluation/benchmark results, and explicit intended-use statements, plus independent corroboration of the card's depth.
